meta.title: AgentBridge — MCP HTTP Transport Lifecycle & Connection Workflow
meta.subtitle: Endpoint Validation, Handshake, Streamable HTTP Dispatch & Teardown
meta.description: Lifecycle finite state machine and error handling workflow governing remote MCP HTTP connections in AgentBridge. Illustrates transitions from DISCONNECTED through CONNECTING, Streamable HTTP POST / Legacy SSE establishment, request dispatching, session ID tracking, disconnect handling, and graceful teardown.

states.label: DISCONNECTED
states.description: Initial state. No HTTP client session exists. Calls to send_request immediately raise ConnectorNotConnectedError.

states.label: Validate Endpoint URL
states.description: Validates URL scheme (http/https), enforces HTTPS for remote hosts unless allow_http=True, and bounds redirects.

states.label: URL Valid & Secure?
states.description: Rejects insecure schemes, non-HTTP protocols, and remote plain HTTP without explicit opt-in.

states.label: ERROR
states.description: Connection or validation failure. State set to ERROR and normalized ConnectorError raised.

states.label: Initialize AsyncClient
states.description: Configures httpx.AsyncClient with connection, read, write, and pool timeouts.

states.label: Legacy SSE Mode?
states.description: Checks config.legacy_sse: if True, establishes GET /sse stream; if False, uses Streamable HTTP directly.

states.label: Connect GET /sse
states.description: Initiates event stream, awaits 'endpoint' event from server, and records announced POST URL.

states.label: CONNECTED
states.description: Transport is connected and ready to dispatch JSON-RPC 2.0 requests over HTTP POST.

states.label: Dispatch POST Request
states.description: Builds headers with auth injection, tracks mcp-session-id, and sends JSON-RPC payload.

states.label: Response Content-Type?
states.description: Routes response parsing to direct JSON reader or streaming SSE chunk reader.

states.label: Initiate Teardown
states.description: transport.close() requested. Transitions state to CLOSING, cancels pending tasks, and releases client.

states.label: CLOSING
states.description: Teardown in progress. New requests rejected, active streams cleanly closed.

states.label: CLOSED / DISCONNECTED
states.description: All resources released, background listeners cancelled. State returned to DISCONNECTED.
